note: Every allowed network flow of the preview runtime (assignment section 19). Anything not listed is denied: the supervisor configures only these paths, services enforce mTLS/TLS identity on each, and the flow verifier probes both the allowed flows (must work) and representative undeclared flows (must be refused). External egress is empty by policy (section 22): the preview runtime itself declares no external destinations; canonical-harness package/advisory egress belongs to the CI environment, not to the deployed runtime.

flows.purpose: single public entry point of the preview environment
routed application traffic to the identity slot
routed application traffic to the membership slot
identity database access as role rt_identity, database epd2_identity
membership database access as role rt_membership, database epd2_membership
voting database access as role rt_voting, database epd2_voting; the only flow crossing into the voting segment's data, isolated by role/database
privacy-safe logs/metrics from the identity slot
privacy-safe logs/metrics from the membership slot
privacy-safe access logs from the ingress boundary

flows.protocol: PostgreSQL over local unix socket (peer auth, instance directory)
flows.purpose: cluster administration, migrations, seed/reset — admin plane, never a TCP exposure

flows.protocol: HTTPS (TLS or mTLS per service declaration)

explicitly_denied_examples: preview-user -> any application/data/voting/observability port (only F01 is public)
ingress-gateway -> voting-runtime-shell (voting is not routable from ingress in preview)
voting-runtime-shell -> observability-collector (voting observability is private by policy)
any service -> external egress (no declared external destination exists)
application-CA client identity -> voting-runtime-shell (wrong trust domain)
